trial_title: Diagnostics for the Treatment of Progressive Mucosal Lesions of the Oral Cavity: a Prospective Study
brief_summary: Despite improvements in therapy, head and neck carcinomas still have a poor prognosis with a 5-year survival of \~ 50%. Malignancies of the head and neck area are (almost) always preceded by precursor lesions. Treatment of these premalignant mucosal abnormalities is generally limited and not very inconvenient for the patient.
